listed_value.definition: The prepared and usually reinforced inclined surface on which keel- and bilge-blocks are laid for supporting a vessel under construction.

listed_value.label: Fender
listed_value.definition: A protective structure designed to cushion the impact of a vessel and prevent damage.

listed_value.label: Solid Face Wharf
listed_value.definition: A wharf consisting of a solid wall of concrete, masonry, wood etc., such that the water cannot circulate freely under the wharf. The type of construction affects ship-handling; for example, a solid face wharf may give shelter from tidal streams, but under certain circumstances a cushion of water may build up between such a wharf and a ship attempting to berth at it, causing difficulties in ship handling.

listed_value.label: Open Face Wharf
listed_value.definition: A wharf supported on piles or other structures which allow free circulation of water under the wharf.

listed_value.label: Log Ramp
listed_value.definition: An inclined plane used to dump logs into the water for transport, or to haul logs out of the water for processing.

listed_value.label: Swimming Facility
listed_value.definition: An artificial pool or swimming enclosure, especially one in the open air, which may be constructed of wire mesh or heavy netting supported by cables, buoys or piles, for swimming in.

listed_value.label: Quay
listed_value.definition: A wharf approximately parallel to the shoreline and accommodating ships on one side only, the other side being attached to the shore. It is usually of solid construction, as contrasted with the open pile construction usually used for piers.

listed_value.label: Tie-Up Wall
listed_value.definition: A section of wall designated for tying-up vessels awaiting transit. Bollards and mooring devices are available for both large and small ships.

name: Category of Signal Station, Traffic
definition: Classification of station based on the traffic service provided.

listed_value.label: Port Control
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels within a port.

listed_value.label: Port Entry and Departure
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a port.

listed_value.label: International Port Traffic
listed_value.definition: A signal station displaying International Port Traffic signals.

listed_value.label: Berthing Signal Station
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels when berthing.

listed_value.label: Dock
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a dock.

listed_value.label: Lock
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a lock.

listed_value.label: Flood Barrage Station
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels wishing to pass through a flood control barrage.

listed_value.label: Bridge Passage
listed_value.definition: A signal station for the control of vessels wishing to pass under a bridge.

listed_value.label: Dredging
listed_value.definition: A signal station indicating when dredging is in progress.

listed_value.label: Traffic Control Light
listed_value.definition: Visual signal lights placed in a waterway to indicate to shipping the movements authorized at the time at which they are shown.

name: Category of Signal Station, Warning
definition: Classification of station based on the warning service provided.

listed_value.label: Danger
listed_value.definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a danger to navigation.

listed_value.label: Maritime Obstruction
listed_value.definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a maritime obstruction.

listed_value.label: Cable
listed_value.definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a cable.

listed_value.label: Military Practice
listed_value.definition: A signal or message warning of activity in a military practice area.

listed_value.label: Distress
listed_value.definition: A station that may receive or transmit distress signals.

listed_value.label: Weather
listed_value.definition: A visual signal displayed to indicate a weather forecast.

listed_value.label: Storm
listed_value.definition: A signal or message conveying information about storm conditions.

listed_value.label: Ice Warning
listed_value.definition: A signal or message conveying information about ice conditions.

listed_value.label: Time
listed_value.definition: An accurate signal marking a specified time or time interval. It is used primarily for determining errors of timepieces. Such signals are usually sent from an observatory by radio, but visual signals are used at some ports.

listed_value.label: Tide
listed_value.definition: A signal or message conveying information on tidal conditions in the area in question.

listed_value.label: Tidal Stream
listed_value.definition: A signal or message conveying information on condition of tidal currents in the area in question.

listed_value.label: Tide Gauge
listed_value.definition: A device for measuring the height of tide. A graduated staff in a sheltered area where visual observations can be made; or it may consist of an elaborate recording instrument making a continuous graphic record of tide height against time. Such an instrument is usually actuated by a float in a pipe communicating with the sea through a small hole which filters out shorter waves.

listed_value.label: Tide Scale
listed_value.definition: A visual scale which directly shows the height of the water above chart datum or a local datum.

listed_value.label: Diving
listed_value.definition: A signal or message warning of diving activity.

listed_value.label: Water Level Gauge
listed_value.definition: A device for measuring and conveying information about the water level (non-tidal) in the area in question.

name: Category of Silo/Tank
definition: Classification based on the product for which a silo or tank is used.

listed_value.label: Silo in General
listed_value.definition: A large storage structure used for storing loose materials.

listed_value.label: Tank in General
listed_value.definition: A fixed structure for storing liquids.

listed_value.label: Grain Elevator
listed_value.definition: A storage building for grain. Usually a tall frame, metal or concrete structure with an especially compartmented interior.

listed_value.label: Water Tower
listed_value.definition: A tower supporting an elevated storage tank of water.

name: Category of Slope
definition: Classification of a stretch of ground forming a natural or artificial incline.

listed_value.label: Cutting
listed_value.definition: An excavation through high ground for a road, canal, etc.

listed_value.label: Embankment
listed_value.definition: A man-made raised long mound of earth or other material.

listed_value.label: Dune
listed_value.definition: A mound, ridge or hill of drifted material on the sea coast or in a desert.

listed_value.label: Hill
listed_value.definition: A small isolated elevation, smaller than a mountain.

listed_value.label: Pingo
listed_value.definition: A dome-shaped hill formed in a permafrost area when the hydrostatic pressure of freezing ground water causes the upheaval of a layer of frozen ground.

listed_value.label: Cliff
listed_value.definition: Land rising abruptly for a considerable distance above the water or surrounding land.

listed_value.label: Scree
listed_value.definition: A mass of detritus, forming a precipitous, strong slope upon a mountain-side. Also the material composing such a slope.

name: Category of Small Craft Facility
definition: Classification of services and facilities for the small craft user.

listed_value.label: Visitors Berth
listed_value.definition: A berth set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

listed_value.label: Nautical Club
listed_value.definition: A club for mariners generally associated with other small craft facilities.

listed_value.label: Boat Hoist
listed_value.definition: A hoist for lifting boats out of the water.

listed_value.label: Sailmaker
listed_value.definition: A place where sails are made or may be taken for repair.

listed_value.label: Boatyard
listed_value.definition: A place on shore where boats may be built, stored and repaired.

listed_value.label: Public Inn
listed_value.definition: A public house providing food, drink and accommodation.

listed_value.label: Restaurant
listed_value.definition: A commercial establishment serving food.

listed_value.label: Chandler
listed_value.definition: A dealer in ships' supplies.

listed_value.label: Provisions
listed_value.definition: A place where food and other such supplies are available.

listed_value.label: Doctor
listed_value.definition: A place where a doctor is available to provide medical attention.

listed_value.label: Pharmacy
listed_value.definition: A place where medical drugs are dispensed.

listed_value.label: Water Tap
listed_value.definition: A place where fresh water is available.

listed_value.label: Fuel Station
listed_value.definition: A place where fuel is available.

listed_value.label: Electricity Outlet
listed_value.definition: A place where a connection to an electrical supply is available.

listed_value.label: Bottle Gas
listed_value.definition: A place where bottled gas is available.

listed_value.label: Showers
listed_value.definition: A place where showers are available.

listed_value.label: Launderette
listed_value.definition: A place where there are facilities for washing clothes.

listed_value.label: Public Toilets
listed_value.definition: A place where toilets are available for public use.

listed_value.label: Post Box
listed_value.definition: A place where mail may be posted.

listed_value.label: Public Telephone
listed_value.definition: A place where a telephone is available for public use.

listed_value.label: Refuse Bin
listed_value.definition: A place where refuse may be dumped.

listed_value.label: Car Park
listed_value.definition: A place where cars may be parked.

listed_value.label: Parking for Boats and Trailers
listed_value.definition: A place on shore where boats and/or trailers may be parked.

listed_value.label: Caravan Site
listed_value.definition: A place where caravans may be parked or where caravan accommodation is provided.

listed_value.label: Camping Site
listed_value.definition: A place where visitors may pitch tents and camp.

listed_value.label: Sewage Pump-Out Station
listed_value.definition: A place where sewage may be pumped off a vessel.

listed_value.label: Emergency Telephone
listed_value.definition: A place where a telephone is available for emergency use only.

listed_value.label: Landing/Launching Place for Boats
listed_value.definition: A place where boats may be landed or launched.

listed_value.label: Scrubbing Berth
listed_value.definition: A place where vessels may berth for the purpose of careening.

listed_value.label: Picnic Area
listed_value.definition: A place where people may go to eat a picnic.

listed_value.label: Mechanics Workshop
listed_value.definition: A place where mechanical repairs can be undertaken to engines or other vessel equipment.

listed_value.label: Guard and/or Security Service
listed_value.definition: A place where a vessel is patrolled by a security service or stored in a secure lockup.

name: Category of Special Purpose Mark
definition: Classification of an aid to navigation which signifies some special purpose.

listed_value.label: Firing Danger Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate a firing danger area, usually at sea.

listed_value.label: Target Mark
listed_value.definition: Any object toward which something is directed. The distinctive marking or instrumentation of a ground point to aid its identification on a photograph.

listed_value.label: Marker Ship Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark marking the position of a ship which is used as a target during some military exercise.

listed_value.label: Degaussing Range Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate a degaussing range.

listed_value.label: Barge Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark of relevance to barges.

listed_value.label: Cable Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_value.label: Spoil Ground Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the limit of a spoil ground.

listed_value.label: Outfall Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.

listed_value.label: ODAS
listed_value.definition: Ocean Data Acquisition System.

listed_value.label: Recording Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to record data for scientific purposes.

listed_value.label: Seaplane Anchorage Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate a seaplane anchorage.

listed_value.label: Recreation Zone Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate a recreation zone.

listed_value.label: Mooring Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a mooring or moorings.

listed_value.label: LANBY
listed_value.definition: A large buoy designed to take the place of a lightship where construction of an offshore light station is not feasible.

listed_value.label: Leading Mark
listed_value.definition: Aids to navigation or other indicators so located as to indicate the path to be followed. Leading marks identify a leading line when they are in transit.

listed_value.label: Measured Distance Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.

listed_value.label: Notice Mark
listed_value.definition: A notice board or sign indicating information to the mariner.

listed_value.label: TSS Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a Traffic Separation Scheme.

listed_value.label: Anchoring Prohibited Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating an anchoring prohibited area.

listed_value.label: Berthing Prohibited Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Overtaking Prohibited Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that overtaking is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Two-Way Traffic Prohibited Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a one-way route.

listed_value.label: Reduced Wake Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.

listed_value.label: Speed Limit Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that a speed limit applies.

listed_value.label: Stop Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.

listed_value.label: General Warning Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the mark.

listed_value.label: Sound Ship's Siren Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.

listed_value.label: Restricted Vertical Clearance Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.

listed_value.label: Maximum Vessel's Draught Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the maximum draught of vessel permitted.

listed_value.label: Restricted Horizontal Clearance Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.

listed_value.label: Strong Current Warning Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark warning of strong currents.

listed_value.label: Berthing Permitted Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that berthing is allowed.

listed_value.label: Overhead Power Cable Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating an overhead power cable.

listed_value.label: Channel Edge Gradient Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.

listed_value.label: Telephone Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the presence of a telephone.

listed_value.label: Ferry Crossing Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route; often used with a 'sound ship's siren' mark.

listed_value.label: Pipeline Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.

listed_value.label: Anchorage Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating an anchorage area.

listed_value.label: Clearing Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate a clearing line.

listed_value.label: Control Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

listed_value.label: Diving Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that diving may take place in the vicinity.

listed_value.label: Refuge Beacon
listed_value.definition: A mark providing or indicating a place of safety.

listed_value.label: Foul Ground Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a foul ground.

listed_value.label: Yachting Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark installed for use by yachtsmen.

listed_value.label: Heliport Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating an area where helicopters may land.

listed_value.label: GNSS Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a location at which a GNSS position has been accurately determined.

listed_value.label: Seaplane Landing Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating an area where seaplanes land.

listed_value.label: Entry Prohibited Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that entry is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Work in Progress Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

listed_value.label: Mark With Unknown Purpose
listed_value.definition: A mark whose detailed characteristics are unknown.

listed_value.label: Wellhead Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.

listed_value.label: Channel Separation Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.

listed_value.label: Marine Farm Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm/culture.

listed_value.label: Artificial Reef Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.

listed_value.label: Ice Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark, used year round, that may be submerged when ice passes through the area.

listed_value.label: Nature Reserve Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to define the boundary of a nature reserve.

listed_value.label: Fish Aggregating Device
listed_value.definition: A fish aggregating (or aggregation) device (FAD) is a man-made object used to attract ocean going pelagic fish such as marlin, tuna and mahi-mahi (dolphin fish). They usually consist of buoys or floats tethered to the ocean floor with concrete blocks or adrift.

listed_value.label: Wreck Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a wreck.

listed_value.label: Customs Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a customs checkpoint.

listed_value.label: Causeway Mark
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a causeway.

listed_value.label: Wave Recorder
listed_value.definition: A surface following buoy used to measure wave activity.

name: Category of Temporal Variation
definition: An assessment of the likelihood of change over time.

listed_value.label: Extreme Event
listed_value.definition: Indication of the possible impact of a significant event (for example hurricane, earthquake, volcanic eruption, landslide, etc), which is considered likely to have changed the seafloor or landscape significantly.

listed_value.label: Likely to Change and Significant Shoaling Expected
listed_value.definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example river siltation, sand waves, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is likely to result in new significant shoaling.

listed_value.label: Likely to Change But Significant Shoaling Not Expected
listed_value.definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example sand wave shift, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is not likely to result in new significant shoaling.

listed_value.label: Likely to Change
listed_value.definition: Continuous or frequent change to non-bathymetric features (for example river siltation, glacier creep/recession, sand dunes, buoys, marine farms, etc).

listed_value.label: Unlikely to Change
listed_value.definition: Significant change to the seafloor is not expected.

listed_value.label: Unassessed
listed_value.definition: Not having been assessed.

name: Category of Structure
definition: Classification of a covered or partially covered area where different use types of vessel can berth.

listed_value.label: Boathouse
listed_value.definition: A building or shed, usually built partly over water, for sheltering a boat or boats.

listed_value.label: Covered Bulk Terminal
listed_value.definition: A covered or partially covered terminal for the handling of bulk materials such as iron ore, coal, etc.

listed_value.label: Covered Wharf
listed_value.definition: A covered or partially covered structure serving as a berthing place for vessels.

listed_value.label: Covered Service Terminal
listed_value.definition: A covered or partially covered terminal within which the floating equipment (dredges, tugs …) of harbour services are berthed and serviced.

listed_value.label: Covered Passenger Terminal
listed_value.definition: A covered or partially covered terminal for the loading and unloading of passengers.

name: Category of Tidal Stream
definition: Classification of the alternating horizontal movement of water associated with the rise and fall of the tide caused by tide producing forces.

listed_value.label: Flood Stream
listed_value.definition: The horizontal movement of water associated with the rising tide. Flood streams generally set towards the shore, or in the direction of the tide progression.

listed_value.label: Ebb Stream
listed_value.definition: The horizontal movement of water associated with falling tide. Ebb streams generally set seaward, or in the opposite direction to the tide progression.

listed_value.label: Other Tidal Flow
listed_value.definition: Any other horizontal movement of water associated with tides, for example rotary flow.

name: Category of Vegetation
definition: Classification of the plant life of an area or region.

listed_value.label: Bush
listed_value.definition: A shrub or clump of shrubs with stems of moderate length.

listed_value.label: Deciduous Wood
listed_value.definition: A wood with trees that shed their leaves annually.

listed_value.label: Coniferous Wood
listed_value.definition: A wood with evergreen trees of a group usually bearing cones, including yews, cedars and redwoods.

listed_value.label: Wood in General (inc Mixed Wood)
listed_value.definition: Growing trees densely occupying a tract of land.

listed_value.label: Reed
listed_value.definition: Any of various water or marsh plants with a firm stem. (Concise Oxford English Dictionary)

listed_value.label: Tree in General
listed_value.definition: An individual woody perennial plant, typically having a single stem or trunk growing to a considerable height and bearing lateral branches at some distance from the ground.

listed_value.label: Evergreen Tree
listed_value.definition: Having green foliage all the year round.

listed_value.label: Coniferous Tree
listed_value.definition: A cone-bearing, needle-leaved or scale-leaved evergreen tree.

listed_value.label: Palm Tree
listed_value.definition: A tropical or sub-tropical tree, shrub or vine having a tall, unbranched, columnar trunk. The trunk is crowned by a tuft or large, pleated fan or feather shaped leaves with stout sheathing and often prickly petioles (stalks), the persistent bases of which frequently clothe the trunk.

listed_value.label: Nipa Palm Tree
listed_value.definition: A rare palm tree with regular branching involving equal or sub-equal division of the apex that results in forking.

listed_value.label: Casuarina Tree
listed_value.definition: A tree characterized by slender, green, often drooping branches that are deeply grooved and that bear, at intervals, whorls of tine leaves.

listed_value.label: Eucalypt Tree
listed_value.definition: An instance of a large genus of mostly very large trees (90 metres).

listed_value.label: Deciduous Tree
listed_value.definition: Sheds its leaves each year at the end of the period of growth.

listed_value.label: Filao Tree
listed_value.definition: Casuarina equisetifolia, the most widespread and well-known member of the family Casuarinaceae.

name: Category of Water Turbulence
definition: Classification of an unstable sea state.

listed_value.label: Breakers
listed_value.definition: A wave breaking on the shore, over a reef, etc. Breakers may be roughly classified into three kinds, although the categories may overlap: spilling breakers break gradually over a considerable distance; plunging breakers tend to curl over and break with a crash; and surging breakers peak up, but then instead of spilling or plunging they surge up on the beach face. The French word 'brisant' is also used for the obstacle causing the breaking of the wave.

listed_value.label: Eddies
listed_value.definition: Circular movements of water usually formed where currents pass obstructions, between two adjacent currents flowing counter to each other, or along the edge of a permanent current.

listed_value.label: Overfalls
listed_value.definition: Short, breaking waves occurring when a strong current passes over a shoal or other submarine obstruction or meets a contrary current or wind.

listed_value.label: Tide Rips
listed_value.definition: Small waves formed on the surface of water by the meeting of opposing tidal currents or by a tidal current crossing an irregular bottom. Vertical oscillation, rather than progressive waves, is characteristic of tide rips.

listed_value.label: Bombora
listed_value.definition: A wave that forms over a submerged offshore reef or rock, sometimes (in very calm weather or at high tide) nearly swelling but in other conditions breaking heavily and producing a dangerous stretch of broken water; the reef or rock itself.

name: Category of Weed/Kelp
definition: Classification of marine vegetation of the algae class.

listed_value.label: Kelp
listed_value.definition: A giant plant sometimes 60 metres long with no roots, it is anchored by hold-fasts or tendrils up to 10 metres long, that cling to rock. Gas filled bubbles on fronds act as floats keeping the kelp just below the surface.

listed_value.label: Seaweed
listed_value.definition: The general name for marine plants of the Algae class which grow in long narrow ribbons.

listed_value.label: Sargasso
listed_value.definition: A certain type of seaweed, or more generally, a large floating mass of this seaweed.

name: Category of Wreck
definition: Classification of a wrecked or ruined ship.

listed_value.label: Non-Dangerous Wreck
listed_value.definition: A wreck which is not considered to be dangerous to surface navigation.

listed_value.label: Dangerous Wreck
listed_value.definition: A wreck submerged at such a depth as to be considered dangerous to surface navigation.

listed_value.label: Distributed Remains of Wreck
listed_value.definition: A substantively decayed wreck over which it is safe to navigate but which should be avoided for anchoring, taking the ground or ground fishing.

listed_value.label: Wreck Showing Mast/Masts
listed_value.definition: Wreck of which only the mast(s) is visible at the sounding datum indicated.

listed_value.label: Wreck Showing Any Portion of Hull or Superstructure
listed_value.definition: Wreck of which any portion of the hull or superstructure is visible at the sounding datum indicated.

name: Category of Zone of Confidence In Data
definition: Classification of the zone of confidence in data within an area based on the positional accuracy, survey equipment and coverage.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence A1
listed_value.definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 5 metres + 5% depth; Depth Accuracy 0.5 metre + 1% depth; Full area search undertaken. Significant seafloor features detected and depths measured; Controlled, systematic survey, high position and depth accuracy achieved using DGPS or a minimum three high quality lines of position (LOP) and a multibeam, channel or mechanical sweep system.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence A2
listed_value.definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 20 metres; Depth Accuracy 1.0 metre + 2% depth; Full area search undertaken. Significant seafloor features detected and depths measured; Controlled, systematic survey achieving position and depth accuracy less than ZOC A1 and using a modern survey echosounder and a sonar or mechanical sweep system.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence B
listed_value.definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 50 metres; Depth Accuracy 1.0 metre + 2% depth; Full area search not achieved, uncharted features hazardous to surface navigation are not expected but may exist; Controlled, systematic survey achieving similar depth but lesser position accuracies than ZOCA2, using a modern survey echosounder, but no sonar or mechanical sweep system.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence C
listed_value.definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 500 metres; Depth Accuracy 2.0 metre + 5% depth; Full area search not achieved, depth anomalies may be expected; Low accuracy survey or data collected on an opportunity basis such as soundings on passage.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence D
listed_value.definition: Positional Accuracy worse than ZOC C; Depth Accuracy worse than ZOC C; Full area search not achieved, large depth anomalies may be expected; Poor quality data or data that cannot be quality assessed due to lack of information.

listed_value.label: Zone of Confidence U
listed_value.definition: The quality of the bathymetric data has yet to be assessed.

name: Colour
definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.

name: Colour Pattern
definition: A regular repeated design containing more than one colour.

listed_value.label: Horizontal Stripes
listed_value.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented horizontally.

listed_value.label: Vertical Stripes
listed_value.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented vertically.

listed_value.label: Diagonal Stripes
listed_value.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented diagonally (that is, not horizontally or vertically).

listed_value.label: Squared
listed_value.definition: Often referred to as checker plate, where alternate colours are used to create squares similar to a chess or draught board. The pattern may be straight or diagonal.

listed_value.label: Stripes (Direction Unknown)
listed_value.definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented in an unknown direction.

listed_value.label: Border Stripe
listed_value.definition: A band or stripe of colour which is displayed around the outer edge of the feature, which may also form a border to an inner pattern or plain colour.

name: Communication Channel
definition: A channel number assigned to a specific radio frequency, frequencies or frequency band.

name: Condition
definition: The various conditions of buildings and other constructions.

listed_value.label: Under Construction
listed_value.definition: Being built but not yet capable of function.

listed_value.label: Ruined
listed_value.definition: A structure in a decayed or deteriorated condition resulting from neglect or disuse, or a damaged structure in need of repair.

listed_value.label: Under Reclamation
listed_value.definition: An area of the sea, a lake or the navigable part of a river that is being reclaimed as land, usually by the dumping of earth and other material.

listed_value.label: Wingless
listed_value.definition: A windmill or wind turbine from which the vanes or turbine blades are missing.

listed_value.label: Planned Construction
listed_value.definition: Detailed planning has been completed but construction has not been initiated.

name: Contact Instructions
definition: Instructions provided on how to contact a particular person, organisation or service.

name: Data Assessment
definition: The categorization of the assessment level of bathymetric data for an area.

listed_value.label: Assessed
listed_value.definition: The quality of the bathymetric data has been assessed.

listed_value.label: Assessed (Oceanic)
listed_value.definition: The quality of oceanic bathymetric data (depths deeper than 200 metres) has been assessed, however details are not required.

listed_value.label: Unassessed
listed_value.definition: Not having been assessed.

name: Date Disused
definition: The date that an entity ceases to be used.

name: Date End
definition: The latest date on which an object (for example a buoy) will be present.

name: Date Fixed
definition: The date of an event.

name: Date Start
definition: The earliest date on which an object (for example a buoy) will be present.

name: Date Variable
definition: A day which is not fixed in the Gregorian calendar.

name: Day of Week
definition: Any one of seven days in a week.

listed_value.label: Sunday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

listed_value.label: Monday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Sunday and preceding Tuesday.

listed_value.label: Tuesday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

listed_value.label: Wednesday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Tuesday and preceding Thursday.

listed_value.label: Thursday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Wednesday and preceding Friday.

listed_value.label: Friday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Thursday and preceding Saturday.

listed_value.label: Saturday
listed_value.definition: The day of the week following Friday and preceding Sunday.

name: Day of Week is Range
definition: A statement expressing if the days of the week identified define a range or not.

name: Default Clearance Depth
definition: The depth value determined for an underwater hazard of unknown depth, based on the depth of the surrounding area.

name: Depth Range Maximum Value
definition: The maximum (deepest) value of a depth range.

name: Depth Range Minimum Value
definition: The minimum (shoalest) value of a depth range.

name: Destination
definition: The place or general direction to which a vessel is going or directed.

name: Distance Mark Visible
definition: A statement indicating whether a distance mark is visible or not.

name: Distance Unit of Measurement
definition: A specified amount of a quantity, as of length, by comparison with which any other quantity of the same kind is measured or estimated.

listed_value.label: Metres
listed_value.definition: The basic unit of length in the International System of Units (SI) system.

listed_value.label: Yards
listed_value.definition: A common unit of linear measure in English-speaking countries, equal to 3 feet or 36 inches, and equivalent to 0.9144 metre.

listed_value.label: Kilometres
listed_value.definition: A unit of length, the common measure of distances equal to 1000 metres, and equivalent to 3280.8 feet or 0.621 mile.

listed_value.label: Statute Miles
listed_value.definition: A unit equal to 5280 feet.

listed_value.label: Nautical Miles
listed_value.definition: A unit of length equal to 1,852 metres. This value was approved by the International Hydrographic Conference of 1929 and has been adopted by nearly all maritime states.

name: Dredged Date
definition: The date that dredging occurred.

name: Elevation
definition: The altitude of the ground level of a feature, measured from a specified vertical datum.

name: Estimated Range of Transmission
definition: The estimated range of a non-optical electromagnetic transmission.

name: Exhibition Condition of Light
definition: The outward display of the light.

listed_value.label: Light Shown Without Change of Character
listed_value.definition: A light shown throughout the 24 hours without change of character.

listed_value.label: Daytime Light
listed_value.definition: A light which is only exhibited by day.

listed_value.label: Fog Light
listed_value.definition: A light which is exhibited in fog or conditions of reduced visibility.

listed_value.label: Night Light
listed_value.definition: A light which is only exhibited at night.

name: Exposition of Sounding
definition: Indicates the relationship of the depth of a feature to the range of depth of the surrounding depth area.

listed_value.label: Within the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
listed_value.definition: The depth corresponds to the depth range of the surrounding depth area; that is, the depth is not shoaler than the minimum depth of the surrounding depth area or deeper than the maximum depth of the surrounding depth area.

listed_value.label: Shoaler Than the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
listed_value.definition: The depth is shoaler than the minimum depth of the surrounding depth area.

listed_value.label: Deeper Than the Range of Depth of the Surrounding Depth Area
listed_value.definition: The depth is deeper than the maximum depth of the surrounding depth area.

name: File Locator
definition: The location of a fragment of text or other information in a support file.

name: File Reference
definition: The file name of an externally referenced text file.

name: Flare Bearing
definition: The bearing about which the light flare symbol is rotated to be displayed in ECDIS.

name: Flare Stack
definition: A tall structure used for burning-off waste oil or gas.

name: Frequency Shore Station Receives
definition: The shore station receiver frequency.

name: Frequency Shore Station Transmits
definition: The shore station transmitter frequency.

name: Drawing Index
definition: A numeric value used to indicate that datasets are intended to form a seamless presentation.

name: Full Seafloor Coverage Achieved
definition: Expression stating if full seafloor coverage has been achieved in the area covered by hydrographic surveys.

name: Function
definition: A specific role that describes a feature.

listed_value.label: Harbour-Masters Office
listed_value.definition: A local official who has charge of mooring and berthing of vessels, collecting harbour fees, etc.

listed_value.label: Customs Office
listed_value.definition: Serves as a government office where customs duties are collected, the flow of goods are regulated and restrictions enforced, and shipments or vehicles are cleared for entering or leaving a country.

listed_value.label: Health Office
listed_value.definition: The office which is charged with the administration of health laws and sanitary inspections.

listed_value.label: Hospital
listed_value.definition: An institution or establishment providing medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.

listed_value.label: Post Office
listed_value.definition: The public department, agency or organisation responsible primarily for the collection, transmission and distribution of mail.

listed_value.label: Hotel
listed_value.definition: An establishment, especially of a comfortable or luxurious kind, where paying visitors are provided with accommodation, meals and other services.

listed_value.label: Railway Station
listed_value.definition: A building with platforms where trains arrive, load, discharge and depart.

listed_value.label: Police Station
listed_value.definition: The headquarters of a local police force and that is where those under arrest are first charged.

listed_value.label: Water-Police Station
listed_value.definition: The headquarters of a local water-police force.

listed_value.label: Pilot Office
listed_value.definition: The office or headquarters of pilots; the place where the services of a pilot may be obtained.

listed_value.label: Pilot Lookout
listed_value.definition: A distinctive structure or place on shore from which personnel keep watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_value.label: Bank Office
listed_value.definition: An office for custody, deposit, loan, exchange or issue of money.

listed_value.label: Headquarters for District Control
listed_value.definition: The quarters of an executive officer (director, manager, etc.) with responsibility for an administrative area.

listed_value.label: Transit Shed/Warehouse
listed_value.definition: A building or part of a building for storage of wares or goods.

listed_value.label: Factory
listed_value.definition: A building or buildings with equipment for manufacturing; a workshop.

listed_value.label: Power Station
listed_value.definition: A stationary plant containing apparatus for large scale conversion of some form of energy (such as hydraulic, steam, chemical or nuclear energy) into electrical energy.

listed_value.label: Administrative
listed_value.definition: A building for the management of affairs.

listed_value.label: Educational Facility
listed_value.definition: An establishment for teaching and learning (for example school, college, university, etc).

listed_value.label: Church
listed_value.definition: A building for public Christian worship.

listed_value.label: Chapel
listed_value.definition: A place for Christian worship other than a parish, cathedral or church, especially one attached to a private house or institution.

listed_value.label: Temple
listed_value.definition: A building for public Jewish worship.

listed_value.label: Pagoda
listed_value.definition: A Hindu or Buddhist temple or sacred building.

listed_value.label: Shinto Shrine
listed_value.definition: A building for public Shinto worship.

listed_value.label: Buddhist Temple
listed_value.definition: A building for public Buddhist worship.

listed_value.label: Mosque
listed_value.definition: A Muslim place of worship.

listed_value.label: Marabout
listed_value.definition: A shrine marking the burial place of a Muslim holy man.

listed_value.label: Lookout
listed_value.definition: Keeping a watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

listed_value.label: Communication
listed_value.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving electronic communication signals.

listed_value.label: Television
listed_value.definition: A system for reproducing on a screen visual images transmitted (usually with sound) by radio signals.

listed_value.label: Radio
listed_value.definition: Transmitting and/or receiving radio-frequency electromagnetic waves as a means of communication.

listed_value.label: Radar
listed_value.definition: A method, system or technique of using beamed, reflected, and timed radio waves for detecting, locating, or tracking objects, and for measuring altitudes.

listed_value.label: Light Support
listed_value.definition: A structure serving as a support for one or more lights.

listed_value.label: Microwave
listed_value.definition: Broadcasting and receiving signals using microwaves.

listed_value.label: Cooling
listed_value.definition: Generation of chilled liquid and/or gas for cooling purposes.

listed_value.label: Observation
listed_value.definition: A place from which the surroundings can be observed but at which a watch is not habitually maintained.

listed_value.label: Timeball
listed_value.definition: A visual time signal in the form of a ball.

listed_value.label: Clock
listed_value.definition: Instrument for measuring time and recording hours.

listed_value.label: Control
listed_value.definition: Used to control the flow of traffic within a specified range of an installation.

listed_value.label: Airship Mooring
listed_value.definition: Equipment or structure to secure an airship.

listed_value.label: Stadium
listed_value.definition: An arena for holding and viewing events.

listed_value.label: Bus Station
listed_value.definition: A building where buses and coaches regularly stop to take on and/or let off passengers, especially for long-distance travel.

listed_value.label: Sea Rescue Control
listed_value.definition: A unit responsible for promoting efficient organization of search and rescue services and for coordinating the conduct of search and rescue operations within a search and rescue region.

listed_value.label: Observatory
listed_value.definition: A building designed and equipped for making observations of astronomical, meteorological, or other natural phenomena.

listed_value.label: Ore Crusher
listed_value.definition: A building or structure used to crush ore.

listed_value.label: Boathouse
listed_value.definition: A building or shed, usually built partly over water, for sheltering a boat or boats.

listed_value.label: Pumping Station
listed_value.definition: A facility to move solids, liquids or gases by means of pressure or suction.

name: Headline
definition: Words set at the head of a passage or page to introduce or categorize.

name: Height
definition: The value of the vertical distance to the highest point of the feature, measured from a specified vertical datum.

name: Horizontal Clearance Length
definition: The length of a feature, such as a lock or basin, which is available for safe navigation. This may, or may not, be the same as the total physical length of the feature.

name: Horizontal Clearance Value
definition: The physical horizontal clearance distance between two points on a feature, such as a bridge span, dock, gate, lock or tunnel.

name: Horizontal Clearance Width
definition: The width of a feature, such as a lock or basin, which is available for safe navigation. This may, or may not, be the same as the total physical width of the feature.

name: Horizontal Distance Uncertainty
definition: The best estimate of the horizontal accuracy of horizontal clearances and distances.

name: Horizontal Length
definition: A measurement of the longer of two linear axis.

name: Horizontal Width
definition: A measurement of the shorter of two linear axis.

name: Ice Factor
definition: The value of the maximum variation in the vertical clearance of an overhead cable due to an accumulation of ice.

name: IMO Adopted
definition: A defined maritime traffic route that has been adopted as an IMO routeing measure.

name: In Dispute
definition: A statement that expresses if an area is in a jurisdictional dispute.

name: Interoperability Identifier
definition: A common unique identifier for entities which describe a single real-world feature, and which is used to identify instances of the feature in end-user systems where the feature may be included in multiple data product types.

name: In the Water
definition: An indication if the feature is located in or over navigable water.

name: Is MRCC
definition: A statement that expresses if a Coast Guard station performs the function of a Maritime Rescue and Coordination Centre.

name: Jurisdiction
definition: The jurisdiction applicable to an administrative area.

listed_value.label: International
listed_value.definition: Involving more than one country; covering more than one national area.

listed_value.label: National
listed_value.definition: An area administered or controlled by a single nation.

listed_value.label: National Sub-Division
listed_value.definition: An area smaller than the nation in which it lies.

name: Language
definition: The method of human communication, either spoken or written, consisting of the use of words in a structured and conventional way.

name: Least Depth of Detected Features Measured
definition: Expression stating if the least depth of detected features in an area was measured.

name: Lifting Capacity
definition: The specific safe lifting capacity of a feature.

name: Light Characteristic
definition: The distinct character, such as fixed, flashing, or occulting, which is given to each light to avoid confusion with neighbouring ones.

listed_value.label: Fixed
listed_value.definition: A signal light that shows continuously, in any given direction, with constant luminous intensity and colour.

listed_value.label: Flashing
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly shorter than the total duration of darkness and all the appearances of light are of equal duration.

listed_value.label: Long-Flashing
listed_value.definition: A single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.

listed_value.label: Quick-Flashing
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 50 flashes per minutes but less than 80 flashes per minutes. It may be: - Continuous quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated. - Group quick-flashing: A quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_value.label: Very Quick-Flashing
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are repeated at a rate of not less than 80 flashes per minute but less than 160 flashes per minute. It may be:- Continuous very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a flash is regularly repeated.- Group very quick-flashing: A very quick-flashing light in which a group of two or more flashes, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.

listed_value.label: Continuous Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which flashes are regularly repeated at a rate of not less than 160 flashes per minute.

listed_value.label: Isophased
listed_value.definition: A light with all durations of light and darkness equal.

listed_value.label: Occulting
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and all the eclipses are of equal duration. It may be:  - Single-occulting: An occulting light in which an eclipse is regularly repeated.  - Group-occulting: An occulting light in which a group of two or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated.  - Composite group-occulting: An occulting light in which a sequence of groups of one or more eclipses, which are specified in number, is regularly repeated, and the groups comprise different numbers of eclipses.

listed_value.label: Interrupted Ultra Quick-Flashing
listed_value.definition: A light in which the ultra quick flashes (160 or more per minute) are interrupted at regular intervals by eclipses of long duration.

listed_value.label: Morse
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which appearances of light of two clearly different durations are grouped to represent a character or characters in the Morse code.

listed_value.label: Fixed and Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_value.label: Flash and Long-Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a flashing light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_value.label: Occulting and Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which an occulting light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_value.label: Fixed and Long-Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a long-flashing light of higher luminous intensity.

listed_value.label: Occulting Alternating
listed_value.definition: An alternating light in which the total duration of light in each period is clearly longer than the total duration of darkness and in which the intervals of darkness (occultations) are all of equal duration.

listed_value.label: Long-Flash Alternating
listed_value.definition: An alternating single-flashing light in which an appearance of light of not less than two seconds duration is regularly repeated.

listed_value.label: Flash Alternating
listed_value.definition: An alternating rhythmic light in which the total duration of light in a period is clearly shorter than the total duration of darkness and all the appearances of light are of equal duration.

listed_value.label: Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_value.label: Very Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of very quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_value.label: Ultra Quick-Flash Plus Long-Flash
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a group of ultra quick flashes is followed by one or more long flashes in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_value.label: Alternating
listed_value.definition: A signal light that shows continuously, in any given direction, two or more colours in a regularly repeated sequence with a regular periodicity.

listed_value.label: Fixed and Alternating Flashing
listed_value.definition: A rhythmic light in which a fixed light is combined with a flashing light of higher luminous intensity and different colour.

name: Light Visibility
definition: The specific visibility of a light, with respect to the light's intensity and ease of recognition.

listed_value.label: High Intensity
listed_value.definition: Non-marine lights with a higher power than marine lights and visible from well off shore (often 'Aero' lights).

listed_value.label: Low Intensity
listed_value.definition: Non-marine lights with lower power than marine lights.

listed_value.label: Faint
listed_value.definition: A decrease in the apparent intensity of a light which may occur in the case of partial obstructions.

listed_value.label: Intensified
listed_value.definition: A light in a sector is intensified (that is, has longer range than other sectors).

listed_value.label: Unintensified
listed_value.definition: A light in a sector is unintensified (that is, has shorter range than other sectors).

listed_value.label: Visibility Deliberately Restricted
listed_value.definition: A light sector is deliberately reduced in intensity, for example to reduce its effect on a built-up area.

listed_value.label: Obscured
listed_value.definition: Said of the arc of a light sector designated by its limiting bearings in which the light is not visible from seaward.

listed_value.label: Partially Obscured
listed_value.definition: This value specifies that parts of the sector are obscured.

listed_value.label: Visible in Line of Range
listed_value.definition: Lights that must be in line to be visible.

name: Line Spacing Maximum
definition: The maximum distance between hydrographic survey lines.

name: Line Spacing Minimum
definition: The minimum distance between hydrographic survey lines.

name: Linkage
definition: Location (address) for online access using a URL/URI address or similar addressing scheme.

name: Magnetic Anomaly Value
definition: The value of the deviation from the normal magnetic variation.

name: Reference Direction
definition: A direction used as a basis for comparison of other directions.

name: Major Light
definition: A statement expressing if a light is considered to be a major light in terms of ECDIS display in a particular area.

name: Marks Navigational - System Of
definition: The system of navigational buoyage a region complies with.

listed_value.label: IALA A
listed_value.definition: Navigational aids conform to the International Association of Lighthouse Authorities - IALA A system.

listed_value.label: IALA B
listed_value.definition: Navigational aids conform to the International Association of Lighthouse Authorities - IALA B system.

listed_value.label: no system
listed_value.definition: Navigational aids do not conform to any defined system.

listed_value.label: main European inland waterway marking system
listed_value.definition: Navigational aids as required in international, national or regional regulations that contain the same navigational aids as the European Code for Inland Waterways of UNECE, or if there is no regulation for a waterway, navigational aids as recommended in the European Code for Inland Waterways of UNECE.

name: Maximum Display Scale
definition: The value considered by the Data Producer to be the maximum (largest) scale at which the data is to be displayed before it can be considered to be "grossly overscaled".

name: Maximum Permitted Draught
definition: The maximum draught of a vessel permitted along a route, in a channel or dock, at a berth, or over a submerged feature.

name: Maximum Permitted Vessel Length
definition: The maximum length of a vessel permitted in a channel or dock, at a berth, or at an anchorage or mooring.

name: Measured Distance
definition: A course at sea, whose ends are indicated by ranges ashore, and whose length has been accurately measured for determining the speed of vessels.

name: Measurement Distance Maximum
definition: The maximum spacing of the principal measurement lines of a hydrographic survey.

name: Measurement Distance Minimum
definition: The minimum spacing of the principal measurement lines of a hydrographic survey.

name: Minimum Display Scale
definition: The smallest intended viewing scale for the data.

name: MMSI Code
definition: The Maritime Mobile Service Identity (MMSI) Code is formed of a series of nine digits which are transmitted over the radio path in order to uniquely identify ship stations, ship earth stations, coast stations, coast earth stations, and group calls. These identities are formed in such a way that the identity or part thereof can be used by telephone and telex subscribers connected to the general telecommunications network principally to call ships automatically.

name: Moire Effect
definition: A short range (up to 2km) type of directional light. Sodium lighting gives a yellow background to a screen on which a vertical black line will be seen by an observer on the centre line.

name: Multiplicity Known
definition: The number of features of identical character that exist as a co-located group is or is not known.

name: Name
definition: The individual name of a feature.

name: Name of Resource
definition: Name of the online resource.

name: Name Usage
definition: Classification of the type and display level of the name of a feature in an end-user system.

listed_value.label: Default Name Display
listed_value.definition: The name is intended to be displayed when the end-user system is set to the default name/text display setting.

listed_value.label: Alternate Name Display
listed_value.definition: The name is intended to be displayed when the end-user system is set to an alternate name/text display setting, for example an alternate language.

name: Nationality
definition: Identifier of membership of a particular nation.

name: Nature of Construction
definition: The building's primary construction material.

listed_value.label: Masonry
listed_value.definition: Constructed of stones or bricks, usually quarried, shaped, and mortared.

listed_value.label: Concreted
listed_value.definition: Constructed of concrete, a material made of sand and gravel that is united by cement into a hardened mass used for roads, foundations, etc.

listed_value.label: Loose Boulders
listed_value.definition: Constructed from large stones or blocks of concrete, often placed loosely for protection against waves or water turbulence.

listed_value.label: Hard Surfaced
listed_value.definition: Constructed with a surface of hard material, usually a term applied to roads surfaced with asphalt or concrete.

listed_value.label: Unsurfaced
listed_value.definition: Constructed with no extra protection, usually a term applied to roads not surfaced with a hard material.

listed_value.label: Wooden
listed_value.definition: Constructed from wood.

listed_value.label: Metal
listed_value.definition: Constructed from metal.

listed_value.label: Glass Reinforced Plastic
listed_value.definition: Constructed from a plastic material strengthened with fibres of glass.

listed_value.label: Latticed
listed_value.definition: A structure of crossed wooden or metal strips usually arranged to form a diagonal pattern of open spaces between the strips.

listed_value.label: Glass
listed_value.definition: [1] Any artificial or natural substance having similar properties and composition, as fused borax, obsidian, or the like.   [2] Something made of such a substance, as a windowpane.

name: Nature of Surface
definition: The general material which the land surface or the seabed is composed.

listed_value.label: Mud
listed_value.definition: Soft, wet earth.

listed_value.label: Clay
listed_value.definition: (Particles of less than 0.002mm); stiff, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked.

listed_value.label: Silt
listed_value.definition: An unconsolidated sediment whose particles range in size from 0.0039 to 0.0625 millimetres in diameter (between clay and sand size).

listed_value.label: Sand
listed_value.definition: Loose material consisting of small but easily distinguishable, separate grains, between 0.0625 and 2.000 millimetres in diameter.

listed_value.label: Stone
listed_value.definition: A general term for rock and rock fragments ranging in size from pebbles and gravel to boulders or large rock masses.

listed_value.label: Gravel
listed_value.definition: (Particles of 2.0 - 4.0mm); small stones with coarse sand.

listed_value.label: Pebbles
listed_value.definition: A small stone worn smooth and rounded by the action of water, sand, ice, etc. ranging in diameter between 4 and 64 millimetres.

listed_value.label: Cobbles
listed_value.definition: A naturally rounded stone larger than a pebble.

listed_value.label: Rock
listed_value.definition: Any formation of natural origin that constitutes an integral part of the lithosphere. The natural occurring material that forms firm, hard, and solid masses.

listed_value.label: Lava
listed_value.definition: The fluid or semi-fluid matter flowing from a volcano. The substance that results from the cooling of the molten rock. Part of the ocean bed is composed of lava.

listed_value.label: Coral
listed_value.definition: Hard calcareous skeletons of many tribes of marine polyps.

listed_value.label: Shells
listed_value.definition: The hard outside covering of an animal. Part of the ocean bed is composed of numerous shells of marine animals.

listed_value.label: Boulder
listed_value.definition: A rounded rock with diameter of 256 millimetres or larger.

name: Nature of Surface - Qualifying Terms
definition: The nature of various forms of natural surface materials in terms of their size, morphology and consistency.

listed_value.label: Fine
listed_value.definition: Falls within the smallest size continuum for a particular nature of surface term.

listed_value.label: Medium
listed_value.definition: Falls within the moderate size continuum for a particular nature of surface term.

listed_value.label: Coarse
listed_value.definition: Falls within the largest size continuum for a particular nature of surface term.

listed_value.label: Broken
listed_value.definition: Fractured or in pieces.

listed_value.label: Sticky
listed_value.definition: Having an adhesive or glue like property.

listed_value.label: Soft
listed_value.definition: Not hard or firm.

listed_value.label: Stiff
listed_value.definition: Not pliant; thick, resistant to flow.

listed_value.label: Volcanic
listed_value.definition: Composed of or containing material ejected from a volcano.

listed_value.label: Calcareous
listed_value.definition: Composed of or containing calcium or calcium carbonate.

listed_value.label: Hard
listed_value.definition: Firm; usually refers to an area of the seafloor not covered by unconsolidated sediment.

name: Number of Features
definition: The number of features of identical character that exist as a co-located group.

name: Opening Bridge
definition: A bridge that is closed when set for carrying road traffic and open when set to permit marine traffic to pass through the waterway it crosses. Modern opening (movable) bridges are either bascule, vertical lift or swing.

name: Orientation Uncertainty
definition: The best estimate of the accuracy of a bearing.

name: Orientation Value
definition: The angular distance measured from true north to the major axis of the feature.

name: Pictorial Representation
definition: The file name of an externally referenced picture file.

name: Pilot Movement
definition: Classification of pilot activity by arrival, departure, or change of pilot. It may also describe the place where the pilot's advice begins, ends, or is transferred to a different pilot.

listed_value.label: Embarkation
listed_value.definition: The place where vessels not being navigated according to a pilot's instructions pick up a pilot while in transit from sea to a port or constricted waters for future navigation under pilot instructions.

listed_value.label: Disembarkation
listed_value.definition: The place where vessels being navigated under a pilot's instructions in transit from sea to a port or constricted waters drop the pilot and proceed without being subject to pilot instructions.

listed_value.label: Pilot Change
listed_value.definition: The place where vessels being navigated under a pilot's instructions drop off the pilot and pick up a different pilot for future navigation under pilot's instructions.

name: Product
definition: The various substances which are transported, stored or exploited.

listed_value.label: Oil
listed_value.definition: A thick, slippery liquid that will not dissolve in water, usually petroleum based in the context of storage tanks.

listed_value.label: Gas
listed_value.definition: A substance with particles that can move freely, usually a fuel substance in the context of storage tanks.

listed_value.label: Water
listed_value.definition: A colourless, odourless, tasteless liquid that is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

listed_value.label: Stone
listed_value.definition: A general term for rock and rock fragments ranging in size from pebbles and gravel to boulders or large rock masses.

listed_value.label: Coal
listed_value.definition: A hard black mineral that is burned as fuel.

listed_value.label: Ore
listed_value.definition: A solid rock or mineral from which metal is obtained.

listed_value.label: Chemicals
listed_value.definition: Any substance obtained by or used in a chemical process.

listed_value.label: Drinking Water
listed_value.definition: Water that is suitable for human consumption.

listed_value.label: Milk
listed_value.definition: A white fluid secreted by female mammals as food for their young.

listed_value.label: Bauxite
listed_value.definition: A mineral from which aluminum is obtained.

listed_value.label: Coke
listed_value.definition: A solid substance obtained after gas and tar have been extracted from coal, used as a fuel.

listed_value.label: Iron Ingots
listed_value.definition: An oblong lump of cast iron metal.

listed_value.label: Salt
listed_value.definition: Sodium chloride obtained from mines or by the evaporation of sea water.

listed_value.label: Sand
listed_value.definition: Loose material consisting of small but easily distinguishable, separate grains, between 0.0625 and 2.000 millimetres in diameter.

listed_value.label: Timber
listed_value.definition: Wood prepared for use in building or carpentry.

listed_value.label: Sawdust/Wood Chips
listed_value.definition: Powdery fragments of wood made in sawing timber or coarse chips produced for use in manufacturing pressed board.

listed_value.label: Scrap Metal
listed_value.definition: Discarded metal suitable for being reprocessed.

listed_value.label: Liquefied Natural Gas
listed_value.definition: Natural gas that has been liquefied for ease of transport by cooling the gas to -162 Celsius.

listed_value.label: Liquefied Petroleum Gas
listed_value.definition: A compressed gas consisting of flammable light hydrocarbons and derived from petroleum.

listed_value.label: Wine
listed_value.definition: The fermented juice of grapes.

listed_value.label: Cement
listed_value.definition: A substance made of powdered lime and clay, mixed with water.

listed_value.label: Grain
listed_value.definition: A small hard seed, especially that of any cereal plant such as wheat, rice, corn, rye etc.

listed_value.label: Electricity
listed_value.definition: Electric charge or current.

listed_value.label: Ice
listed_value.definition: The solid form of water.

listed_value.label: Clay
listed_value.definition: (Particles of less than 0.002mm); stiff, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked.

name: Quality of Horizontal Measurement
definition: The degree of reliability attributed to a position.

listed_value.label: Approximate
listed_value.definition: A position that is considered to be less than third-order accuracy, but is generally considered to be within 30.5 metres of its correct geographic location. Also may apply to a feature whose position does not remain fixed.

name: Quality of Vertical Measurement
definition: The reliability of the value of a sounding.

listed_value.label: Depth Known
listed_value.definition: The depth from the chart datum to the seabed (or to the top of a drying feature) is known.

listed_value.label: Depth or Least Depth Unknown
listed_value.definition: The depth from chart datum to the seabed, or the shoalest depth of the feature is unknown.

listed_value.label: Doubtful Sounding
listed_value.definition: A depth that may be less than indicated.

listed_value.label: Unreliable Sounding
listed_value.definition: A depth that is considered to be an unreliable value.

listed_value.label: Least Depth Known
listed_value.definition: The shoalest depth over a feature is of known value.

listed_value.label: Least Depth Unknown, Safe Clearance at Value Shown
listed_value.definition: The least depth over a feature is unknown, but there is considered to be safe clearance at this depth.

listed_value.label: Value Reported (Not Surveyed)
listed_value.definition: Depth value obtained from a report, but not fully surveyed.

listed_value.label: Value Reported (Not Confirmed)
listed_value.definition: Depth value obtained from a report, which it has not been possible to confirm.

listed_value.label: Maintained Depth
listed_value.definition: The depth at which a channel is kept by human influence, usually by dredging.

listed_value.label: Not Regularly Maintained
listed_value.definition: Depths may be altered by human influence, but will not be routinely maintained.

name: Radar Band
definition: The band code character of the electromagnetic spectrum within which radar wave lengths lie.

name: Radar Conspicuous
definition: A feature which returns a strong radar echo.

name: Radius
definition: The vector extending from the centre to the periphery of a circular or spherical feature.

name: Reference Location
definition: Information relating to the point of origin for a measured distance as indicated on a distance mark.

name: Reference Tide
definition: The reference tide to which the series of tidal stream values apply.

listed_value.label: High Water
listed_value.definition: The highest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

listed_value.label: Low Water
listed_value.definition: The lowest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

name: Reference Tide Type
definition: The type of tide range (that is, mean spring tide, mean neap tide or mean tide) for which a set of tidal stream rates and directions apply.

listed_value.label: Springs
listed_value.definition: The tides of increased range occurring near the times of full moon and new moon.

listed_value.label: Neaps
listed_value.definition: The tides of decreased range occurring near the times of first and last quarter.

listed_value.label: Mean
listed_value.definition: The tides of mean range occurring between spring and neap tides.

name: Reference Year for Magnetic Variation
definition: The reference calendar year for magnetic variation values.

name: Regulation Citation
definition: The regulation citation for a feature.

name: Reported Date
definition: The date that the item was observed, done, or investigated.

name: Restriction
definition: The official legal statute of each kind of restricted area.

listed_value.label: Anchoring Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which anchoring is not permitted.

listed_value.label: Anchoring Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which anchoring is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Fishing Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which fishing is not permitted.

listed_value.label: Fishing Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which fishing is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Trawling Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which trawling is not permitted.

listed_value.label: Trawling Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which trawling is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Entry Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which navigation and/or anchoring is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Entry Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which navigation is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Dredging Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which dredging is not permitted.

listed_value.label: Dredging Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which dredging is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Diving Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which diving is not permitted.

listed_value.label: Diving Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which diving is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: No Wake
listed_value.definition: Mariners must adjust the speed of their vessels to reduce the wave or wash which may cause erosion or disturb moored vessels.

listed_value.label: Area To Be Avoided
listed_value.definition: An IMO declared routeing measure comprising an area within defined limits in which either navigation is particularly hazardous or it is exceptionally important to avoid casualties and which should be avoided by all ships, or certain classes of ships.

listed_value.label: Construction Prohibited
listed_value.definition: The erection of permanent or temporary fixed structures or artificial islands is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Discharging Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which discharging or dumping is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Discharging Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which discharging or dumping is restricted in accordance with specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Industrial or Mineral Exploration/Development Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which industrial or mineral exploration and development are prohibited.

listed_value.label: Industrial or Mineral Exploration/Development Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which industrial or mineral exploration and development is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Drilling Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which excavating a hole on the seabed with a drill is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Drilling Restricted
listed_value.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which excavating a hole on the seabed with a drill is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

listed_value.label: Removal of Historical Artefacts Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which the removal of historical artefacts is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Cargo Transhipment (Lightening) Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area in which cargo transhipment (lightening) is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Dragging Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area in which the dragging of anything along the seabed, for example bottom trawling, is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Stopping Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area in which a vessel is prohibited from stopping.

listed_value.label: Landing Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area in which landing is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Speed Restricted
listed_value.definition: An area within which speed is restricted.

listed_value.label: Swimming Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area in which swimming is prohibited.

listed_value.label: Power-Driven Vessels Prohibited
listed_value.definition: An area within which any vessel propelled by machinery is prohibited.

name: Scale Minimum
definition: The minimum scale at which the feature may be used for example for ECDIS presentation.

name: Scale Value Maximum
definition: The largest scale for the range of survey scale.

name: Scale Value Minimum
definition: The smallest scale for the range of survey scale.

name: Sector Bearing
definition: A sector is the part of a circle between two straight lines drawn from the centre to the circumference. Sector bearing specifies the limit of the sector.

name: Sector Arc Extension
definition: An indication that the default radius of a sector arc is to be extended by 5mm.

name: Sector Line Length
definition: A sector is the part of a circle between two straight lines drawn from the centre to the circumference. Sector line length specifies the displayed length of the line, in ground units, defining the limit of the sector.

name: Signal Duration
definition: The time occupied by a single instance of light/sound or eclipse/silence in a signal sequence.

name: Signal Frequency
definition: The frequency of a signal.

name: Signal Generation
definition: The mechanism used to generate a fog or light signal.

listed_value.label: Automatically
listed_value.definition: Signal generation is initiated by a self regulating mechanism such as a timer or light sensor.

listed_value.label: By Wave Action
listed_value.definition: The signal is generated by the motion of the sea surface such as a bell in a buoy.

listed_value.label: By Hand
listed_value.definition: The signal is generated by a manually operated mechanism such as a hand cranked siren.

listed_value.label: By Wind
listed_value.definition: The signal is generated by the motion of air such as a wind driven whistle.

listed_value.label: Radio Activated
listed_value.definition: Activated by radio signal.

listed_value.label: Call Activated
listed_value.definition: Activated by making a call to a manned station.

name: Signal Group
definition: The number of signals, the combination of signals or the morse character(s) within one period of full sequence.

name: Signal Period
definition: The time occupied by an entire cycle of intervals of light and eclipse.

name: Signal Status
