definition: The indication of an element of a signal sequence being a period of light/sound or eclipse/silence.

listed_value.label: Lit/Sound
listed_value.definition: The indication of an element of a signal sequence being a period of light or sound.

listed_value.label: Eclipsed/Silent
listed_value.definition: The indication of an element of a signal sequence being a period of eclipse or silence.

name: Significant Features Detected
definition: A statement expressing if significant features have or have not been detected in the course of a survey.

name: Size of Features Detected
definition: The size of detected bathymetric features in an area.

name: Source
definition: The publication, document, or reference work from which information comes or is acquired.

name: Speed Limit
definition: The maximum allowed rate of travel in an area.

name: Speed Maximum
definition: Rate of motion. The terms speed and velocity are often used interchangeably, but speed is a scalar, having magnitude only, while velocity is a vector quantity, having both magnitude and direction. Speed maximum is the maximum rate of travel that can occur.

name: Speed Minimum
definition: Rate of motion. The terms speed and velocity are often used interchangeably, but speed is a scalar, having magnitude only, while velocity is a vector quantity, having both magnitude and direction. Speed minimum is the minimum rate of travel that can occur.

name: Speed Units
definition: The units for description of speed.

listed_value.label: Kilometres Per Hour
listed_value.definition: A unit of speed, expressing the number of kilometres travelled in one hour.

listed_value.label: Miles Per Hour
listed_value.definition: An imperial and United States customary unit of speed expressing the number of statute miles covered in one hour.

listed_value.label: Knots
listed_value.definition: A nautical unit of speed. One knot is one nautical mile per hour. The name is derived from the knots in the log line.

name: Station Name
definition: The name of the reference tide station with reference water level for tidal stream panel observations.

name: Station Number
definition: The identification number of the reference tide station with reference water level for tidal stream panel observations.

name: Status
definition: The condition of an object at a given instant in time.

listed_value.label: Permanent
listed_value.definition: Intended to last or function indefinitely.

listed_value.label: Occasional
listed_value.definition: Acting on special occasions; happening irregularly.

listed_value.label: Recommended
listed_value.definition: Presented as worthy of confidence, acceptance, use, etc.

listed_value.label: Not in Use
listed_value.definition: Use has ceased, but the facility still exists intact; disused.

listed_value.label: Periodic/Intermittent
listed_value.definition: Recurring at intervals.

listed_value.label: Reserved
listed_value.definition: Set apart for some specific use.

listed_value.label: Temporary
listed_value.definition: Meant to last only for a time.

listed_value.label: Private
listed_value.definition: Administered by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.

listed_value.label: Mandatory
listed_value.definition: Compulsory; enforced.

listed_value.label: Extinguished
listed_value.definition: No longer lit.

listed_value.label: Illuminated
listed_value.definition: Lit by flood lights, strip lights, etc.

listed_value.label: Historic
listed_value.definition: Famous in history; of historical interest.

listed_value.label: Public
listed_value.definition: Belonging to, available to, used or shared by, the community as a whole and not restricted to private use.

listed_value.label: Synchronized
listed_value.definition: Occur at a time, coincide in point of time, be contemporary or simultaneous.

listed_value.label: Watched
listed_value.definition: Looked at or observed over a period of time especially so as to be aware of any movement or change.

listed_value.label: Unwatched
listed_value.definition: Usually automatic in operation, without any permanently-stationed personnel to superintend it.

listed_value.label: Existence Doubtful
listed_value.definition: A feature that has been reported but has not been definitely determined to exist.

listed_value.label: Buoyed
listed_value.definition: Marked by buoys.

name: Stream Depth
definition: The depth below the sea surface to which the tidal stream data refers relative to the sounding datum.

name: Surrounding Depth
definition: The depth value determined for seabed around an underwater hazard, based on the depth of the surrounding area.

name: Survey Authority
definition: The authority which was responsible for the survey.

name: Survey Type
definition: Classification of the different survey types.

listed_value.label: Reconnaissance/Sketch Survey
listed_value.definition: A survey made (due to lack of time or facilities) to a lower degree of accuracy and detail than the chosen scale would normally indicate.

listed_value.label: Controlled Survey
listed_value.definition: A thorough survey usually conducted with reference to guidelines.

listed_value.label: Examination Survey
listed_value.definition: A survey principally aimed at the investigation of underwater obstructions and dangers.

listed_value.label: Passage Survey
listed_value.definition: A survey where soundings are acquired by vessels on passage.

listed_value.label: Remotely Sensed
listed_value.definition: A survey where features have been positioned and delimited using remote sensing techniques.

listed_value.label: Full Coverage
listed_value.definition: A survey achieving 100% coverage using systematic, controlled techniques providing full seafloor coverage or full coverage to a defined depth and an investigation of all contacts.

listed_value.label: Systematic Survey
listed_value.definition: A controlled survey but full coverage may not have been achieved.

listed_value.label: Non-Systematic Survey
listed_value.definition: A survey of lower quality than a full coverage and systematic survey. Such surveys may be further categorized as reconnaissance, sketch, track, passage, remotely sensed and spot-sounding surveys.

listed_value.label: Inadequately Surveyed
listed_value.definition: Not surveyed to modern standards; or due to its age, scale, or positional or vertical uncertainties is not suitable to the type of navigation expected in the area.

listed_value.label: Spot-Sounding Survey
listed_value.definition: A survey that uses a regular (for example grid) or irregular pattern of soundings obtained one at a time, and normally with very wide spacing.

listed_value.label: Acoustically Swept Survey
listed_value.definition: A controlled, systematic survey to standard accuracy; using modern survey echo sounder with sonar sweep.

listed_value.label: Mechanically Swept Survey
listed_value.definition: Swept areas where the clearance depth is accurately known but the actual seabed depth is not accurately known.

name: Update Number
definition: Update number of the ENC being referenced.

name: Update Type
definition: An action performed when the contents of a dataset are changed.

listed_value.label: Insert
listed_value.definition: To put or introduce into the body of something.

listed_value.label: Delete
listed_value.definition: To eliminate especially by removing, cutting out or erasing.

listed_value.label: Modify
listed_value.definition: To make basic or fundamental changes to the characteristics of something, often to give a new orientation to or to serve a new end.

listed_value.label: Move
listed_value.definition: To change the place or position of something.

name: Swept Date
definition: The date that the area was swept by a survey.

name: Technique of Vertical Measurement
definition: Survey method used to obtain depth information.

listed_value.label: Found by Echo Sounder
listed_value.definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that determines depth of water by measuring the time interval between emission of a sonic or ultrasonic signal and return of its echo from the bottom.

listed_value.label: Found by Side Scan Sonar
listed_value.definition: The depth was computed from a record produced by active sonar in which fixed acoustic beams are directed into the water perpendicularly to the direction of travel to scan the seabed and generate a record of the seabed configuration.

listed_value.label: Found by Multi Beam
listed_value.definition: The depth was measured by using a wide swath echo sounder that uses multiple beams to measure depths directly below and transverse to the ship's track.

listed_value.label: Found by Diver
listed_value.definition: The depth was determined by a person skilled in the practice of diving.

listed_value.label: Found by Lead Line
listed_value.definition: The depth was measured by using a line, graduated with attached marks and fastened to a sounding lead.

listed_value.label: Swept by Vertical Acoustic System
listed_value.definition: The given area has been swept using a system comprised of multiple echo sounder transducers attached to booms deployed from the survey vessel.

listed_value.label: Found by Electromagnetic Sensor
listed_value.definition: The depth was determined by using an instrument that compares electromagnetic signals.

listed_value.label: Photogrammetry
listed_value.definition: The science or art of obtaining reliable measurements from photographs.

listed_value.label: Satellite Imagery
listed_value.definition: The depth was determined by using instruments placed aboard an artificial satellite.

listed_value.label: Found by Levelling
listed_value.definition: The depth was determined by using levelling techniques to find the elevation of the point relative to a datum.

listed_value.label: Swept by Side Scan Sonar
listed_value.definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a side scan sonar.

listed_value.label: Found by LIDAR
listed_value.definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that measures distance by emitting timed pulses of laser light and measuring the time between emission and reception of the reflected pulses.

listed_value.label: Synthetic Aperture Radar
listed_value.definition: A radar with a synthetic aperture antenna which is composed of a large number of elementary transducing elements. The signals are electronically combined into a resulting signal equivalent to that of a single antenna of a given aperture in a given direction.

listed_value.label: Hyperspectral Imagery
listed_value.definition: Term used to describe the imagery derived from subdividing the electromagnetic spectrum into very narrow bandwidths. These narrow bandwidths may be combined with or subtracted from each other in various ways to form images useful in precise terrain or target analysis.

listed_value.label: Mechanically Swept
listed_value.definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a line or object below the surface at the desired depth; or least depth(s) and position(s) within an area was identified using the same technique.

name: Telecommunication Identifier
definition: An identifier, such as words, numbers, letters, symbols, or any combination of those used to establish a contact to a particular person, organisation or service.

name: Telecommunication Service
definition: Classification of methods of communication over a distance by electrical, electronic, or electromagnetic means.

listed_value.label: Voice
listed_value.definition: The transfer or exchange of information by using sounds that are being made by mouth and throat when speaking.

listed_value.label: Facsimile
listed_value.definition: A system of transmitting and reproducing graphic matter (as printing or still pictures) by means of signals sent over telephone lines.

listed_value.label: SMS
listed_value.definition: Short Message Service is a form of text messaging communication on phones and mobile phones.

listed_value.label: Data
listed_value.definition: A representation of facts, concepts or instructions in a formalised manner suitable for communication, interpretation or processing.

listed_value.label: Streamed Data
listed_value.definition: Data that is constantly received by and presented to an end-user while being delivered by a provider.

listed_value.label: Telex
listed_value.definition: A system of communication in which messages are sent over long distances by using a telephone system and are printed by using a special machine (called a teletypewriter).

listed_value.label: Telegraph
listed_value.definition: An apparatus, system or process for communication at a distance by electric transmission over wire.

listed_value.label: Email
listed_value.definition: Messages and other data exchanged between individuals using computers in a network.

name: Text
definition: A non-formatted digital text string.

name: Text Offset Bearing
definition: The angular distance measured from true north that text associated with a feature is positioned from the feature in an end-user system.

name: Text Offset Distance
definition: The distance that text associated with a feature is positioned from the feature in an end-user system.

name: Text Rotation
definition: A statement that expresses if text associated with a feature is to be rotated in the ECDIS display or not.

name: Text Type
definition: The attribute from which a text string is derived.

listed_value.label: Name
listed_value.definition: The individual name of a feature.

listed_value.label: Feature Characteristic
listed_value.definition: A distinguishing trait, quality, or property of a feature class.

name: Time of Day End
definition: The time corresponding to the end of an active period.

name: Time of Day Start
definition: The time corresponding to the start of an active period.

name: Time Relative to Tide
definition: The time difference relative to the reference tide.

name: Topmark/Daymark Shape
definition: The shape a topmark or daymark exhibits.

listed_value.label: Cone (Point Up)
listed_value.definition: Is where the vertex points up.

listed_value.label: Cone (Point Down)
listed_value.definition: Is where the vertex points down.

listed_value.label: Sphere
listed_value.definition: A curved surface all points of which are equidistant from a fixed point within, called the centre.

listed_value.label: 2 Spheres
listed_value.definition: Two spheres, one above the other. Two black spheres are commonly used as an International Association of Lighthouse Authorities - IALA topmark (isolated danger).

listed_value.label: Cylinder
listed_value.definition: A solid geometrical figure generated by straight lines fixed in direction and describing with one of point a closed curve, especially a circle (in which case the figure is circular cylinder, its ends being parallel circles).

listed_value.label: Board
listed_value.definition: Usually of rectangular shape, made from timber or metal and used to provide a contrast with the natural background of a daymark. The actual daymark is often painted on to this board.

listed_value.label: X-Shaped
listed_value.definition: Having a shape or a cross-section like the capital letter X.

listed_value.label: Upright Cross
listed_value.definition: A cross with one vertical member and one horizontal member; that is, similar in shape to the character '+'.

listed_value.label: Cube (Point Up)
listed_value.definition: A cube standing on one of its vertexes. A cube is a solid contained by six equal squares, a regular hexahedron.

listed_value.label: 2 Cones (Point to Point)
listed_value.definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices together in the centre.

listed_value.label: 2 Cones (Base to Base)
listed_value.definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their bases together in the centre and their vertices pointing up and down.

listed_value.label: Rhombus
listed_value.definition: A plane figure having four equal sides and equal opposite angles (two acute and two obtuse); an oblique equilateral parallelogram.

listed_value.label: 2 Cones (Points Upward)
listed_value.definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices pointing up.

listed_value.label: 2 Cones (Points Downward)
listed_value.definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices pointing down.

listed_value.label: Besom (Point Up)
listed_value.definition: A bundle of rods or twigs. A besom, point up is where the thicker (untied) end of the besom is at the bottom.

listed_value.label: Besom (Point Down)
listed_value.definition: A bundle of rods or twigs. A besom, point down is where the thinner (tied) end of the besom is at the bottom.

listed_value.label: Flag
listed_value.definition: A flag mounted on a short pole.

listed_value.label: Sphere Over a Rhombus
listed_value.definition: A sphere located above a rhombus.

listed_value.label: Square
listed_value.definition: A plane figure with four right angles and four equal straight sides.

listed_value.label: Rectangle (Horizontal)
listed_value.definition: A horizontal rectangle is where the two longer opposite sides are standing horizontally.

listed_value.label: Rectangle (Vertical)
listed_value.definition: A vertical rectangle is where the two longer opposite sides are standing vertically.

listed_value.label: Trapezium (Up)
listed_value.definition: A quadrilateral having one pair of opposite sides parallel, and which stands on its longer parallel side.

listed_value.label: Trapezium (Down)
listed_value.definition: A quadrilateral having one pair of opposite sides parallel, and which stands on its shorter parallel side.

listed_value.label: Triangle (Point Up)
listed_value.definition: A figure having three angles and three sides, and which has a vertex at the top.

listed_value.label: Triangle (Point Down)
listed_value.definition: A figure having three angles and three sides, and which has a side at the top.

listed_value.label: Circle
listed_value.definition: A perfectly round plane figure whose circumference is everywhere equidistant from its centre.

listed_value.label: Two Upright Crosses (One Over the Other)
listed_value.definition: Two upright crosses, generally vertically disposed one above the other.

listed_value.label: T-Shape
listed_value.definition: Having a shape like the capital letter T.

listed_value.label: Triangle Pointing Up Over a Circle
listed_value.definition: A triangle, vertex uppermost, located above a circle.

listed_value.label: Upright Cross Over a Circle
listed_value.definition: An upright cross located above a circle.

listed_value.label: Rhombus Over a Circle
listed_value.definition: A rhombus located above a circle.

listed_value.label: Circle Over a Triangle Pointing Up
listed_value.definition: A circle located over a triangle, vertex uppermost.

listed_value.label: Other Shape (See Shape Information)
listed_value.definition: An uncommon and/or non-standardized shape as textually described using an associated attribute.

name: Traffic Flow
definition: Direction of vessels passing a reference point.

listed_value.label: Inbound
listed_value.definition: Traffic flow in a general direction toward a port or similar destination.

listed_value.label: Outbound
listed_value.definition: Traffic flow in a general direction away from a port or similar point of origin.

listed_value.label: One-Way
listed_value.definition: Traffic flow in one general direction only.

listed_value.label: Two-Way
listed_value.definition: Traffic flow in two generally opposite directions.

name: Uncertainty Fixed
definition: The best estimate of the fixed horizontal or vertical accuracy component for positions, depths, heights, vertical distances and vertical clearances.

name: Uncertainty Variable Factor
definition: The factor to be applied to the variable component of an uncertainty equation so as to provide the best estimate of the variable horizontal or vertical accuracy component for positions, depths, heights, vertical distances and vertical clearances.

name: Underlying Layer
definition: The position of the seabed type within the layers of the seabed.

name: Value of Annual Change in Magnetic Variation
definition: The annual change in magnetic variation values.

name: Value of Depth Contour
definition: The depth of a sea bottom contour.

name: Value of Magnetic Variation
definition: The angle between the magnetic and geographical meridians at any place, expressed in degrees east or west to indicate the direction of magnetic north from true north.

name: Value of Maximum Range
definition: The extreme distance at which a feature can be seen or a signal detected.

name: Value of Nominal Range
definition: The luminous range of a light in a homogenous atmosphere in which the meteorological visibility is 10 sea miles.

name: Value of Sounding
definition: The value of the measurement of a sounding relative to the chart datum.

name: Vertical Clearance Unlimited
definition: A statement that expresses if the vertical clearance for a feature in the open position, such as a bridge span, is unlimited.

name: Vertical Clearance Value
definition: The vertical clearance measured from the horizontal plane towards the feature overhead.

name: Vertical Datum
definition: The reference level used for expressing the vertical measurements of points on the earth's surface. Also called datum level, reference plane, levelling datum, datum for sounding reduction, datum for heights.

listed_value.label: Mean Low Water Springs
listed_value.definition: The average height of the low waters of spring tides. This level is used as a tidal datum in some areas.

listed_value.label: Mean Lower Low Water Springs
listed_value.definition: The average height of lower low water springs at a place.

listed_value.label: Mean Sea Level
listed_value.definition: The average height of the surface of the sea at a tide station for all stages of the tide over a 19-year period, usually determined from hourly height readings measured from a fixed predetermined reference level.

listed_value.label: Lowest Low Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest tide observed at a place, or somewhat lower.

listed_value.label: Mean Low Water
listed_value.definition: The average height of all low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_value.label: Lowest Low Water Springs
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest water level observed at a place at spring tides during a period of time shorter than 19 years.

listed_value.label: Approximate Mean Low Water Springs
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water Springs (MLWS).

listed_value.label: Indian Spring Low Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary tidal datum approximating the level of the mean of the lower low water at spring tides. It was first used in waters surrounding India.

listed_value.label: Low Water Springs
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean low water springs (MLWS).

listed_value.label: Approximate Lowest Astronomical Tide
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT).

listed_value.label: Nearly Lowest Low Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level approximating the lowest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the Indian Spring Low Water (ISLW).

listed_value.label: Mean Lower Low Water
listed_value.definition: The average height of the lower low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_value.label: Low Water
listed_value.definition: The lowest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

listed_value.label: Approximate Mean Low Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water (MLW).

listed_value.label: Approximate Mean Lower Low Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW).

listed_value.label: Mean High Water
listed_value.definition: The average height of all high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_value.label: Mean High Water Springs
listed_value.definition: The average height of the high waters of spring tides.

listed_value.label: High Water
listed_value.definition: The highest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

listed_value.label: Approximate Mean Sea Level
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Sea Level (MSL).

listed_value.label: High Water Springs
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean high water springs (MHWS).

listed_value.label: Mean Higher High Water
listed_value.definition: The average height of higher high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

listed_value.label: Equinoctial Spring Low Water
listed_value.definition: The level of low water springs near the time of an equinox.

listed_value.label: Lowest Astronomical Tide
listed_value.definition: The lowest tide level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

listed_value.label: Local Datum
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary datum defined by a local harbour authority, from which levels and tidal heights are measured by this authority.

listed_value.label: International Great Lakes Datum 1985
listed_value.definition: A vertical reference system with its zero based on the mean water level at Rimouski/Pointe-au-Père, Quebec, over the period 1970 to 1988.

listed_value.label: Mean Water Level
listed_value.definition: The average of all hourly water levels over the available period of record.

listed_value.label: Lower Low Water Large Tide
listed_value.definition: The average of the lowest low waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

listed_value.label: Higher High Water Large Tide
listed_value.definition: The average of the highest high waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

listed_value.label: Nearly Highest High Water
listed_value.definition: An arbitrary level approximating the highest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the high water springs.

listed_value.label: Highest Astronomical Tide
listed_value.definition: The highest tidal level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

listed_value.label: Baltic Sea Chart Datum 2000
listed_value.definition: The datum refers to each Baltic country's realization of the European Vertical Reference System (EVRS) with land-uplift epoch 2000, which is connected to the Normaal Amsterdams Peil (NAP).

name: Vertical Length
definition: The total vertical length of a feature.

name: Vessel Class
definition: The classification of a vessel, normally as defined by length or gross tonnage.

name: Virtual AIS Aid to Navigation Type
definition: A purpose of a virtual AIS Aid to Navigation.

listed_value.label: North Cardinal
listed_value.definition: Indicates that it should be passed to the north side of the aid.

listed_value.label: East Cardinal
listed_value.definition: Indicates that it should be passed to the east side of the aid.

listed_value.label: South Cardinal
listed_value.definition: Indicates that it should be passed to the south side of the aid.

listed_value.label: West Cardinal
listed_value.definition: Indicates that it should be passed to the west side of the aid.

listed_value.label: Port Lateral (IALA A)
listed_value.definition: Indicates the port boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the “conventional direction of buoyage” in the IALA A system.

listed_value.label: Starboard Lateral (IALA A)
listed_value.definition: Indicates the starboard boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the “conventional direction of buoyage” in the IALA A system.

listed_value.label: Port Lateral (IALA B)
listed_value.definition: Indicates the port boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the “conventional direction of buoyage” in the IALA B system.

listed_value.label: Starboard Lateral (IALA B)
listed_value.definition: Indicates the starboard boundary of a navigational channel or suggested route when proceeding in the “conventional direction of buoyage” in the IALA B system.

listed_value.label: Isolated Danger
listed_value.definition: A mark used alone to indicate a dangerous reef or shoal. The mark may be passed on either hand.

listed_value.label: Safe Water
listed_value.definition: Indicates that there is navigable water around the mark.

listed_value.label: Special Purpose
listed_value.definition: A special purpose aid is primarily used to indicate an area or feature, the nature of which is apparent from reference to a chart, Sailing Directions or Notice to Mariners.

listed_value.label: Emergency Wreck Marking
listed_value.definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a recent wreck.

name: Visitors Mooring
definition: A mooring set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

name: Visual Prominence
definition: The extent to which a feature, either natural or artificial, is visible from seaward.

listed_value.label: Visually Conspicuous
listed_value.definition: Term applied to an object either natural or artificial which is distinctly and notably visible from seaward.

listed_value.label: Not Visually Conspicuous
listed_value.definition: An object that may be visible from seaward, but cannot be used as a fixing mark and is not conspicuous.

listed_value.label: Prominent
listed_value.definition: Objects which are easily identifiable, but do not justify being classed as conspicuous.

name: Water Level Effect
definition: The effect of the surrounding water on an object.

listed_value.label: Partly Submerged at High Water
listed_value.definition: Partially covered and partially dry at high water.

listed_value.label: Always Dry
listed_value.definition: Not covered at high water under average meteorological conditions.

listed_value.label: Always Under Water/Submerged
listed_value.definition: Remains covered by water at all times under average meteorological conditions.

listed_value.label: Covers and Uncovers
listed_value.definition: Expression intended to indicate an area of a reef or other projection from the bottom of a body of water which periodically extends above and is submerged below the surface. Also referred to as dries or uncovers.

listed_value.label: Awash
listed_value.definition: Flush with, or washed by the waves at low water under average meteorological conditions.

listed_value.label: Subject to Inundation or Flooding
listed_value.definition: An area periodically covered by flood water, excluding tidal waters.

listed_value.label: Floating
listed_value.definition: Resting or moving on the surface of a liquid without sinking.

name: Waterway Distance
definition: The length of the space between two points along a waterway.

name: Wave Length Value
definition: The distance between two successive peaks (or other points of identical phase) on an electromagnetic wave.

name: Category of Cargo
definition: Classification of the different types of cargo that a ship may be carrying.

listed_value.label: Bulk
listed_value.definition: Unpacked homogenous cargo poured loose in a certain space of a vessel, for example oil or grain.

listed_value.label: Container
listed_value.definition: One of a number of standard sized cargo carrying units, secured using standard corner attachments and bar.

listed_value.label: General
listed_value.definition: Break bulk cargo normally loaded by crane.

listed_value.label: Liquid
listed_value.definition: Any cargo loaded by pipeline.

listed_value.label: Passenger
listed_value.definition: A fee paying traveller.

listed_value.label: Livestock
listed_value.definition: Live animals carried in bulk.

listed_value.label: Dangerous or Hazardous
listed_value.definition: Dangerous or hazardous cargo as described by the IMO International Maritime Dangerous Goods code.

listed_value.label: Heavy Lift
listed_value.definition: Indivisible heavy items of weight generally over 100 tons, and width or height greater than 100 metres.

listed_value.label: Ballast
listed_value.definition: Material carried by a ship to ensure its stability.

listed_value.label: Dry Bulk Cargo
listed_value.definition: Commodity cargo that is transported unpackaged in large quantities. These types of goods usually need to be kept dry during the whole transportation period.

listed_value.label: Liquid Bulk Cargo
listed_value.definition: Liquids or gases that are transported in bulk and carried unpackaged.

listed_value.label: Reefer Container Cargo
listed_value.definition: Cargo transported in refrigerated containers, generally perishable commodities which require temperature-controlled transportation, such as fruit, meat, fish, vegetables, dairy products and other foods.

listed_value.label: Ro-Ro Cargo
listed_value.definition: Wheeled cargo, such as cars, busses, trucks, agricultural vehicles and cranes, that are driven on and off the ship on their own wheels or using a platform vehicle, such as a self-propelled modular transporter.

listed_value.label: Project Cargo
listed_value.definition: Project cargo is a term used to broadly describe the national or international transportation of large, heavy, high value, or critical (to the project they are intended for) pieces of equipment. Also commonly referred to as heavy lift, this includes shipments made of various components which need disassembly for shipment and reassembly after delivery.

listed_value.label: Break Bulk Cargo
listed_value.definition: Goods that are stowed on board ship in individually counted units, and not in intermodal containers nor in bulk as with oil or grain.

name: Minimum Berth Depth
definition: The least depth of the body of water at the berth or in a berth pocket adjacent to the berth.

name: Optimum Display Scale
definition: The largest intended viewing scale for the data.

name: Drawing Instruction
definition: Text describing one or more graphic elements that must be rendered in an end-user system.
